'''Camar''' is a Bent Peak [[Daryne]] [[Aiel]] from the ''[[Seia Doon]]'' society. 

==Appearance==
He is rangy with gray hair. He is extremely tall, half a head taller than Rand, and around [[List of character heights|6'10" or 208 cm]].

==Activities==
He leads the ''Seia Doon'' bodyguard when [[Rand al'Thor]] meets with the [[Sea Folk]].
